title: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery files for review and approval by the Department a Firm Transportation Agreement with Bardon Trimount Corporation d/b/a Aggregate Industries (Hyannis, MA).
petitioner: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman: Commissioners W. Robert Keating Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. and Deirdre K. Manning. (DTE 04-GC-22)
